note: Input is synthetic clean TTS speech fed in real time (20 ms packets, one thread), not real microphones. The LLM returns the whole reply before TTS starts, so Replies are played in real time by the fake player (sleep for the PCM duration), so a turn takes its full audio length. Reply path is the production TurnManager: streamed Spark text through FallbackChatProvider (listen.llm defaults, model auto), StreamChunker caps from listen.reply (8/12), the TTS length cap, the early backchannel and the trimmed BackchannelCache; max_new_tokens comes from listen.reply.max_new_tokens via the production provider (no override). The in-process LLM is not loaded at startup. Stage keys keep their old names but now mean: asr->llm = ASR done to first chunk text ready (time to first chunk); llm->tts1 = first chunk ready to its TTS+RVC audio ready; tts1->audio = audio ready to playback start (waits for the backchannel clip to finish); total = end of speech to first reply audio. Loaders get hub ids under HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
